subject.title: Dashboard: new data-binding kinds — stream, command, computed

question: Should the modular dashboard roadmap include allowlisted periodic command bindings, or should command execution be split into a separate security-reviewed design after stream and computed bindings are settled?
rationale: Automation can verify the current absence of the feature, but it cannot choose the security boundary for scheduled command execution inside dashboard data resolution or decide whether this apps-layer capability belongs in bundled OpenClaw now.

options.title: Split command execution out
options.body: Proceed only after the dashboard substrate lands, handle stream/computed binding design first, and require a separate maintainer-approved command-binding proposal.

options.title: Approve all three binding kinds together
options.body: Allow stream, computed, and command bindings as one feature, with the implementation carrying the full allowlist, permission, audit, and live-proof burden.

options.title: Defer the apps-layer binding roadmap
options.body: Keep this as roadmap context but pause implementation until maintainers decide whether bundled modular dashboard apps are current product work.

recommendation.title: Split command execution out
recommendation.body: Proceed only after the dashboard substrate lands, handle stream/computed binding design first, and require a separate maintainer-approved command-binding proposal.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest merged-history signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and the security/product boundary this dashboard roadmap builds on.
